newsitem.title: BELGIUM: East European parliaments urged to help in Albania.
newsitem.headline: East European parliaments urged to help in Albania.

text.p: European Parliament President Jose-Maria Gil-Robles urged central and east European parliaments on Wednesday to help resolve the political crisis which has plunged Albania into a state of near anarchy.

"I invite you to join me in calling on the authorities and the different political factions to put an end to the clashes which have taken place over the last few days and cooperate in seeking a peaceful and democratic solution to the serious crisis facing this country," Gil-Robles told parliament leaders meeting in Brussels.
He said he hoped the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe and the EU's Council of Ministers would act as mediators "if this should prove necessary".
The parliamentary leaders of the Baltic states and six other nations were in Brussels for two days of talks to discuss preparations for their accession to the EU.
Bulgaria, which is currently holding elections, did not attend.
